description: A wire basket sits on the table with a small metal tray of colorful plastic utensils in front of it, and more utensils are off to the right. The right hand reaches to the tray at the front of the basket, lifts it up and to the right, tips it to dump the utensils onto the tabletop, then brings the now-empty metal tray back left and slides it into the front of the wire basket while the left hand stays resting nearby.
